answer: Courier time-window registration makes each identity claim a distinct scheduled handoff with an independent courier at a checkpoint near the ridge. The checkpoint signs one active claim per window and rejects duplicates, so each extra identity costs a separate courier trip, a signed handoff, and a full 20 min wait. A claim at the lotus market cannot reuse a window from another site. A claim at the river wharf expires unless its courier confirms the handoff in person.
